name: Company brain
blurb: A company's people, projects, claims, decisions and commitments, each tied to the exact words it rests on, shared by its people and agents.
about: A company brain is one shared record of what a company knows: who is on which team, what each project is, what was said, what was decided and who owes what. This one is a typed graph in which every claim carries the exact quote it rests on, so people and agents read the same account and can check it. Agents propose changes on their own branches, and a person reviews and merges them. It takes the place of searching chat logs and wiki pages that drift apart.

questions.q: Which decisions are current, project by project?
Which decisions rest on a claim that someone has since contradicted?
What does this decision rest on, and in whose words?
What did this meeting commit people to?

search.title: Company brain: a context graph for people and agents
search.heading: A context graph of a company's decisions, claims and commitments
